Success criteria: The stapler is on the display stand and close to it in both the left-right and front-back directions; both grippers are open at completion.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping flatter areas along the stapler's long sides near its base, leaving fingertip clearance above the table and avoiding grasping only the movable blue lever. Match the opening to local width and confirm the fingers surround the body before closing.
- During transport or reorientation, keep the stapler bottom and fingertips above the display stand edge, avoiding a low lateral collision that could hit the edge or push the stand away.
- Lower slowly toward the flat support area of the black platform, avoiding the raised front edge. Release after the stapler bottom is supported, then withdraw upward to reduce dragging the stand or tipping the stapler.
